answer: Sybil attacks try to flood an agent economy with identities as numberless as grains in a shifting dune. One concrete defense: require every new agent to post a ferrous, hard-to-forge stake-bond, then grow trust only along a trellis of peer attestations earned through verified work. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs a thousand slashable bonds, so the arithmetic of faking identities collapses before it starts.
